displayTitle: Jedi Academy: Revenge of the Sis
synopsis: Jedi Academy: Revenge of the Sis is the seventh volume in the Star Wars: Jedi Academy young-readers series and the first to feature Christina Starspeeder as the protagonist.An all-new story arc begins in the New York Times bestselling series, with author Amy Ignatow and illustrator Jarret Krosockza in Star Wars: Jedi Academy! Starring Christina Starspeeder!As told through a mix of comics, doodles, and journal entries, Christina Starspeeder takes us on a new adventure at an all-new Jedi academy campus! There are unfamiliar faces and old ones too, but one thing remains the same: Jedi Academy is full of laughs and warm moments that fans and readers discovering the series for the first time will love.
title: Jedi Academy: Revenge of the Sis
